cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose the Relationship
cards.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put on my good jacket like you. Finally, a proper dinner together. Your mother's dumplings are ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm dressed for the networking dinner. The director's coming; I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, a dinner worth dressing for. Sit down with me tonight. I don't want to keep being the meal you come home after.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll eat them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then call the director and offer tomorrow. I'd like to be the dinner you don't move.
